title: 第9章 全球直播
content_zh:
第9章全球直播
回到明月市好几天了，黎渺渺也从滨海回来，生活物品都搬到了新房。新房是明月市郊区的一座独栋别墅，虽然地段赶不上爸妈的老宅，但面积要大得多。
别墅的地下室足有两百平，许景明改造成了专业的练功房。
别墅的院子，也有八百平，其中部分区域也建成了露天练武场。比如有一根大木桩就插在院子内，大木桩足有四十公分粗，长三米，其中插入地下一米，地上两米。
许景明穿着背心裤衩，光着脚，一个上步就是双掌拍在大木桩上。
上步时，速度爆发极强，令全身速度立即提起来，就仿佛一头暴起的猛虎，而后双掌猛地拍击在大木桩上。
“嘭！！！”
四十公分粗的木桩，都被撞击的剧烈震颤。
跟着许景明退了一步，又再次上步，一步便已经暴起，双掌再度拍击木桩上。拍击十次后，许景明又换招数，肩撞、背撞、肘撞……
每一次撞击，木桩都剧烈震颤。
“景明，今晚去我爸妈那边吃晚饭吧。”黎渺渺戴着虚拟眼镜，走到客厅门口，倚靠着门口，看着院子内练桩功的许景明。
“行啊。”许景明嘴上应着，“不过你准备什么时候搬到这边住？”
“怎么，一个人晚上孤独难耐了？”黎渺渺似笑非笑瞥了眼许景明，打趣道。
“一个人是挺冷清的。”许景明停下练拳，看向黎渺渺。
“看你可怜兮兮的样子。”黎渺渺笑了，说道，“我刚回明月市几天而已，多陪陪我爸妈嘛。”黎渺渺说道，让她一天二十四小时待在父母身边，也头疼，年轻人也是需要空间的。
白天，她都是在新房这，晚上去父母那边睡觉，陪母亲聊聊天。
“过些天，我爸妈也就嫌我了。”黎渺渺说道，“到时候我就过来。”
“好。”许景明点头道，“对了，我明天要陪爷爷去一趟医院，估计白天都不在这边。”
“那我明天就不过来了。”黎渺渺走回客厅，又沉浸在虚拟网络中。
许景明也继续练拳。

忽然——
坐在客厅沙发中的黎渺渺，露出了震惊色，仔细浏览着虚拟网络中的新闻
“景明，景明，出大事了！”客厅中的黎渺渺惊呼。
“嘭。”
双拳砸在木桩上的许景明，被女友的惊呼也吓了一跳，停了下来：“怎么了？”说着也走进了客厅。
“你快看。”黎渺渺站在客厅中，划了一个手势，客厅半空中便有光幕凝聚显现，光幕中正有着视频播放。
“全球195个国家，同时宣布，将在三日后，也就是京城时间7月21日晚9点，举行一场发布会。届时全球195个国家会同时直播。”
“京城时间晚9点、大都会时间早晨8点、雾都时间下午1点、江户时间晚10点……全球不同时区，全部同一时间进行发布会！一定是大事，了不得的大事，上次如此大动静，还是全球195个国家组成蓝星联盟。”
“关于这场发布会，现在没有任何消息透露出来，越是如此保密，就越是大事。”
一条条短视频，在光幕中一条条滑过。
如今整个网络都被突如其来的消息炸得沸腾了，无数网民在发表看法。
“的确是大事！”许景明郑重道，“很可能是影响全球人类命运的大事。”
“全球国家太多了。”黎渺渺也点头道，“说是195个国家，可实际上有些小国，还赶不上我们夏国的一个小镇。195个国家同时宣布，这是一种态度！上一次如此郑重，还是组建蓝星联盟，去开发荧火星。”
“当初人类第一次登上荧火星，之后各国疯狂发展航天技术，争着开发荧火星。最终全球195个国家还是组建了蓝星联盟，一起合力开发荧火星。”许景明点头，“组建蓝星联盟开发荧火星，是过去几十年最大的事。这次不知道是为了什么。”
“网上议论纷纷，但没有任何消息透露，处于完全保密状态。”黎渺渺也很关注。
“保密程度很高啊。”许景明有着期待，“看三天后的直播吧。”
全球都为这场发布会为沸腾，网络上的话题大半都是谈论即将举行的发布会。因为如此大动静，过去百年只发生过一次，那次是组建蓝星联盟。
这次，又是为了什么？
时间一天天过去，还是来到了7月21号，夏国京城时间晚8点55分。
“马上要全球直播了。”

“不知道什么大事。”
许景明的新房处，许老爷子、许景明的父母、黎渺渺的父母还有许景明黎渺渺，这一大家子人都聚在客厅内，光幕中早就锁定了全球直播。
京城，柳海的住处。
“爸，你知道这次全球直播，是什么大事么？”柳海住处也聚集了一大家子人，也都等待着这次全球直播发布会。
“我也不清楚，保密级别很高。”柳海坐在那，说道，“别急，几分钟后就正式宣布了，看了就知道了。”
柳海虽然不清楚，但听上面说过一句：“这次的国家重点栽培名单，和7月21日的全球直播发布会有关。”
“全球直播发布会，到底是什么大事？”
程氏家族也齐聚。
一家之主程立韦和夫人，还有大儿子程子佟一家、二儿子程子豪。
“爸，以你的关系网都不知道这次发布会的事？”程子豪翘着腿坐在沙发上，吃着香蕉，惊讶问道。
他父亲程立韦，可是市值五万亿的巨无霸公司“虎鲨集团”的掌控人，影响力可能比一些小国首脑还大，在这颗星球上，连他都不知道的秘密，那显然保密级别极高了。
“不知道。”程立韦郑重道，“我打听过，这次说是195个国家同时发布，实际上绝大多数国家首脑都不知道，只有联盟的32个议员国才知道秘密。”
蓝星联盟，一般事情是五大理事国商议就能决定了，就算决定全球命运的大事，32个议员国便可决定。至于更多小国？在联盟中是挥旗子吆喝的，并无决定权，他们只有服从联盟决定的权力。
“如果影响全球人类命运，那么也一定会影响我们虎鲨集团命运。”程立韦说道，“好好看看这次发布会。”
程子佟、程子豪也都仔细看着。
当年蓝星联盟组建，各国交流大大提高，虎鲨集团就吃到了红利，将集团渗透到全球多个国家。
一个强大的集团，必须得紧跟世界大势，顺势而为。
这一刻，夏国、罗马国、白鹰联邦、天竺国、樱花国等等，全球各个国家地区，不管是白天还是黑夜，不管是富有还是贫穷，大半的全球人们都在看着这场直播。
网络上所有娱乐停掉，所有直播平台、视频平台，以及所有官方媒体，不管怎么刷新，都只有一个节目：这场全球直播的发布会！
甚至街道上各种大屏幕，广告屏幕……也都在播放这场发布会。

此刻，生活在这颗星球上的人们，想要不知道这场直播，反而很难。
“要开始了！”
许景明、黎渺渺他们一大家子人都坐在客厅中，观看着屏幕中的直播画面。
直播画面中，一百九十五个国家代表都已就座，坐在主位上的则是蓝星联盟如今这一届的秘书长安格斯。
“我很荣幸，能够主持这次发布会，因为，这将是一场载入我们人类史册的发布会。”安格斯秘书长微笑说道，他说的是罗马语，但在夏国境内的所有媒体，播放出的语音就是汉语，在樱花国播放的便是日语……各国听到的语音，都是各国通用语。
content_en:
Chapter 9 Global Live Broadcast
After returning to Mingyue City for several days, Li Miaomiao also came back from Binhai and moved all his daily belongings to his new house. The new house is a single-family villa in the suburbs of Mingyue City. Although the location is not as good as my parents' old house, the area is much larger.
The basement of the villa is 200 square meters, and Xu Jingming transformed it into a professional practice room.
The courtyard of the villa is also 800 square meters, and part of the area has also been built as an open-air martial arts training ground. For example, there is a large wooden stake inserted in the yard. The large wooden stake is forty centimeters thick and three meters long. One meter is inserted into the ground and two meters above the ground.
Xu Jingming was wearing a vest and underpants with bare feet. He took a step forward and slapped his palms on the big wooden pile.
When taking a step forward, the speed explodes so strongly that the whole body immediately picks up speed, like a violent tiger, and then slams his palms on the big wooden stake.
"Bang!!!"
The forty centimeter thick wooden pile was shaken violently by the impact.
Following Xu Jingming, he took a step back, then stepped forward again. With one step, he suddenly rose up, and slapped his palms on the wooden stake again. After slapping ten times, Xu Jingming changed his tactics again, shoulder butt, back butt, elbow butt...
The stakes shook violently with each impact.
"Jingming, let's go to my parents' place for dinner tonight." Li Miaomiao wore virtual glasses and walked to the door of the living room, leaning against the door and looking at Xu Jingming who was practicing pile kung fu in the yard.
"Okay." Xu Jingming responded, "But when are you going to move here?"
"Why, are you so lonely at night?" Li Miaomiao glanced at Xu Jingming with a half-smile and joked.
"It's quite lonely to be alone." Xu Jingming stopped practicing boxing and looked at Li Miaomiao.
"Look at how pitiful you are." Li Miaomiao smiled and said, "I have just returned to Mingyue City for a few days. Please spend more time with my parents." Li Miaomiao said that it was a headache for her to stay with her parents 24 hours a day. Young people also need space.
During the day, she stayed in her new house, and at night she went to her parents' place to sleep and chat with her mother.
"In a few days, my parents will dislike me." Li Miaomiao said, "I will come over then."
"Okay." Xu Jingming nodded and said, "By the way, I have to go to the hospital with grandpa tomorrow. I probably won't be here during the day."
"Then I won't come over tomorrow." Li Miaomiao walked back to the living room and was immersed in the virtual network again.
Xu Jingming also continued to practice boxing.
suddenly——
Li Miaomiao, who was sitting on the sofa in the living room, looked shocked and carefully browsed the news on the virtual network.
"Jingming, Jingming, something big happened!" Li Miaomiao exclaimed in the living room.
"Bang."
Xu Jingming, who hit the wooden stake with both fists, was startled by his girlfriend's exclamation and stopped: "What's wrong?" He also walked into the living room.
"Look." Li Miaomiao stood in the living room and made a gesture. A light curtain appeared in mid-air in the living room, and a video was playing in the light curtain.
"195 countries around the world announced at the same time that they will hold a press conference three days later, on July 21 at 9 pm Beijing time. At that time, 195 countries around the world will broadcast live."
"9 p.m. Beijing time, 8 a.m. metropolitan time, 1 p.m. Fog City time, 10 p.m. Edo time... different time zones around the world, all press conferences at the same time! It must be a big event, a huge event. The last time there was such a big move, 195 countries around the world formed the Blue Star Alliance."
"About this press conference, no information has been revealed now. The more confidential it is, the more important it is."
One short video after another slides through the light curtain.
Now the entire Internet is abuzz with the sudden news, and countless netizens are expressing their opinions.
"It is indeed a major event!" Xu Jingming said solemnly, "It is likely to be a major event that affects the destiny of mankind around the world."
"There are too many countries in the world." Li Miaomiao also nodded, "It is said that there are 195 countries, but in fact there are someIt’s a small country, but it can’t keep up with a small town in our Xia country. 195 countries announced at the same time, this is an attitude! The last time we were so solemn, we formed the Blue Star Alliance to develop Ying Mars. "
“When humans first landed on the glowing Mars, then various countries developed aerospace technology frantically and competed to develop the glowing Mars. In the end, 195 countries around the world formed the Blue Star Alliance to work together to develop Glowing Mars. "Xu Jingming nodded, "The formation of the Blue Star Alliance to develop Ying Mars is the biggest event in the past few decades. I don’t know why this time. "
“There is a lot of chatter online, but no information has been revealed and it is completely confidential. "Li Miaomiao is also very concerned.
“The level of confidentiality is very high. Xu Jingming looked forward to it, "Let's watch the live broadcast in three days." "
The whole world is excited about this conference, and most of the topics on the Internet are talking about the upcoming conference. Because of such a big movement, it has only happened once in the past hundred years, and that time was the formation of the Blue Star Alliance.
This time, for what?
Time passed day by day, and it was still July 21st, 8:55 pm in the capital of Xia Kingdom.
“It will be broadcast live around the world soon. "
“I don’t know what the big deal is. "
At Xu Jingming's new house, Mr. Xu, Xu Jingming's parents, Li Miaomiao's parents, and Xu Jingming and Li Miaomiao were all gathered in the living room, and the global live broadcast had been locked on the light screen.
The capital, Liu Hai’s residence.
"Dad, do you know what a big deal this global live broadcast is? "A large family also gathered at Liu Hai's residence, all waiting for this global live broadcast conference.
“I don’t know, the level of confidentiality is very high. Liu Hai sat there and said, "Don't worry, it will be officially announced in a few minutes. You will know after reading it." "
Although Liu Hai didn't know it clearly, he heard someone say: "This national key cultivation list is related to the global live broadcast conference on July 21. "
"What is the big deal about the global live broadcast conference? "
The Cheng family also gathered.
The head of the family is Cheng Liwei and his wife, as well as the eldest son Cheng Zitong and the second son Cheng Zihao.
“Dad, even with your connections, you don’t even know about this press conference? Cheng Zihao asked in surprise as he sat on the sofa with his legs crossed, eating a banana.
His father, Cheng Liwei, is the controller of the "Tiger Shark Group", a giant company with a market value of 5 trillion. His influence may be greater than that of some heads of small countries. On this planet, there are secrets that even he does not know, and those secrets are obviously kept under a very high level of confidentiality.
"Don't know. "Cheng Liwei said solemnly, "I have inquired and it was said that 195 countries released it at the same time this time. In fact, most heads of state do not know about it. Only the 32 member states of the alliance know the secret. "
In the Blue Star Alliance, general matters can be decided by the five major council members through consultation. Even major events that determine the fate of the world can be decided by the 32 member states. As for more small countries? In the alliance, they wave the flag and have no decision-making power. They only have the power to obey the alliance's decisions.
“If it affects the destiny of mankind around the world, it will definitely affect the destiny of our Tiger Shark Group. "Cheng Liwei said, "Take a good look at this press conference. "
Cheng Zitong and Cheng Zihao also watched carefully.
When the Blue Star Alliance was formed, exchanges between countries were greatly improved, and the Tiger Shark Group reaped the dividends and penetrated the group into many countries around the world.
A strong group must keep up with the general trend of the world and take advantage of it.
At this moment, Xia Kingdom, Roman Kingdom, White Eagle Federation, Tianzhu Kingdom, Sakura Kingdom, etc., all countries and regions around the world, whether it is day or night, whether rich or poor, most of the people in the world are watching this live broadcast.
All entertainment on the Internet has stopped, all live broadcast platforms, video platforms, and all official media, no matter how refreshed, there is only one program: this global live broadcast conference!
Even the various large screens and advertising screens on the streets...Everyone is playing this press conference.
At this moment, it is difficult for people living on this planet not to know about this live broadcast.
"It's about to begin!"
Xu Jingming, Li Miaomiao and their entire family were sitting in the living room, watching the live broadcast on the screen.
In the live broadcast, one hundred and ninety-five country representatives were seated, and sitting at the main seat was Angus, the current Secretary-General of the Blue Star Alliance.
"I am honored to be able to host this press conference, because this will be a press conference that will be recorded in the annals of our human history." Secretary-General Angus said with a smile. He spoke in Roman, but all the media in the Xia Kingdom broadcast the voice in Chinese, and the voice broadcast in the Sakura Kingdom was Japanese... The voices heard by all countries are the lingua franca of each country.
